top_signals.title: House passes bill to equip local law enforcement with scam-fighting tools
top_signals.summary: The Guarding Unprotected Aging Retirees from Deception Act (GUARD) attempts to address a common complaint from the victims of online scams like pig butchering — that such cases typically do not rise to the level of a federal investigation but local law enforcement is unequipped to properly investigate them.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
top_signals.summary: The legislation seeks to codify Trump’s Bitcoin reserve policy, locking up Bitcoin acquired through civil and criminal forfeiture for 20 years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Microsoft says Copilot buttons still missing in classic Outlook
top_signals.summary: Microsoft says it's still investigating a known issue that causes the Copilot and Copilot Chat buttons in Classic Outlook to disappear for some Windows users. [...]

top_signals.title: Webinar: What happens in the first hours of a Google Workspace breach
top_signals.summary: The first hours after discovering a Google Workspace breach can determine how an incident unfolds. This webinar examines real-world breaches to show which early response decisions can limit the impact and which can make matters worse. [...]
